therapeutic_hypothesis.compound: pertuzumab in combination with trastuzumab and paclitaxel
therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: dual HER2 blockade with pertuzumab and trastuzumab plus microtubule stabilization with paclitaxel
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: HER2 signaling inhibition and mitotic disruption in tumor cells
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: percentage of patients who are progression free at 6 months or later

results.dose_information: paclitaxel 80 mg/m2 weekly + trastuzumab 8 mg/kg loading then 6 mg/kg every 3 weeks + pertuzumab 840 mg loading then 420 mg every 3 weeks, all IV

context.duration: treatment until progression, follow-up up to 24 months
